title: Rebuilding a call stack
hints: The frame chain is a linked list in memory: `[rbp]` is the next `rbp`, `[rbp + 8]` the return address. Collect return addresses as you follow it, with every stop condition checked before moving on.
To find the nearest symbol, go through all of the module's symbols and keep the one with the largest RVA that is still at or below the address's RVA.
